title: sceptridium obliquum var. intermedium
intro: Sceptridium obliquum var. intermedium, commonly known as Chinese Queen or Intermediate Chinese Queen fern, is a type of plant species in the family Liliaceae. It is used in traditional Chinese medicine and has been found to have various health benefits, including anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties. The therapeutic actions of Sceptridium obliquum var. intermedium include immune system modulation, cardiovascular protection, and anti-cancer activities, which are attributed to its bioactive constituents such as phenolic acids, flavonoids, and saponins. However, more research is needed to fully understand its effects and potential uses, and it should be used under the guidance of a qualified healthcare professional.
